zh: 所有元素都是正整数，固定右端点时，合法的左端点构成一个后缀：左端越往右，乘积越小。
用滑动窗口维护以当前右端点结尾、乘积不超过 k 的最长窗口；加入右端后，若乘积超过 k 就不断从左端移出元素。
维护 product、left 和计数；每加入 a[right] 就把 product 乘上它；当 left≤right 且 product>k 时除以 a[left] 并右移 left；然后计数加上 right−left+1；答案最大约 1.25×10^11，用 64 位整数。
en: All elements are positive integers, so for a fixed right end the valid left ends form a suffix: the further right the left end, the smaller the product.

Use a sliding window that keeps the longest window ending at the current right end with product at most k; after adding the right element, keep removing elements from the left while the product exceeds k.

Keep product, left and a counter; multiply product by a[right] for each new element; while left <= right and product > k, divide by a[left] and advance left; then add right - left + 1 to the counter. The answer can reach about 1.25 * 10^11, so use a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Use a sliding window over positive numbers: after adding the right end, shrink the left end until the product is <= k, then add the current window length.

## Proof of correctness

All elements are at least 1, so for a fixed right end the valid starting points form a suffix. Shrinking stops at the earliest valid start, so the window length is exactly the number of valid subarrays ending at that right end, and summing counts each subarray exactly once.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) space besides the input; the answer can reach 125000250000, so use 64-bit integers.
